tasks.title: Route takeoff measurements to trades at the seam
tasks.notes: Every measurement collapses into one anonymous kind=custom $0 line (TakeoffEstimateSeeder). Fix: switch on kind — area(SF)->flooring, derived-wall->painting, LF->per-LF trim.

prep.what: Fix `TakeoffEstimateSeeder` to route each measurement kind to the correct trade estimate line instead of collapsing everything into one useless `kind=custom $0` line.
prep.understand: Right now, a flooring measurement and a painting measurement both become the same anonymous custom line with $0 price — the kind and geometry are thrown away. The fix switches on `kind`: area(SF) → flooring LaborRate+MaterialTier, wall-derived(SF) → painting rate, LF → per-LF trim. Note: the LF lane requires t47 (PerLinearFt RateType) to exist — if not done yet, ship the area+wall lanes first and gate trim.
approach: Open `TakeoffEstimateSeeder` — find where measurements collapse to `kind=custom` with $0 price.
Inspect the `kind` values available on measurement records (area, wall-derived, lf, etc.).
Add a switch/match: `area` → lookup flooring LaborRate + MaterialTier; `wall-derived` → painting rate; `lf` → per-LF trim rate (skip if t47 not done).
Carry the geometry quantity (SF or LF value) onto the seeded line item so estimates show real quantities.
Test with a real takeoff: confirm you get distinct flooring, painting, and trim lines instead of one custom line.
resources: `TakeoffEstimateSeeder` class
Measurement `kind` enum/constants in the codebase
`LaborRate` and `MaterialTier` models and their lookup methods
t47 (PerLinearFt RateType) — check if it's done before building the trim lane
A test takeoff project on staging to validate output

tasks.title: Critical problem with marking invoices as paid manually
tasks.notes: When a client pays outside QB channels, manually marking as paid goes to project incorrectly instead of recording the payment against the invoice.

prep.what: Fix a critical billing bug: 'mark as paid manually' redirects to the project page instead of recording a payment record against the invoice.
prep.understand: When GS clients pay by wire or cash, QB's poller misses it. The operator needs to manually mark the invoice paid — but the current flow ends up on the project page instead, leaving the invoice in an unpaid state and breaking AR reconciliation. This is a real revenue tracking bug.
approach: Reproduce: find an open invoice in GS-ERP and click 'Mark as paid manually' — observe where it redirects.
Check the network tab: which controller and route handles this action? Confirm it's POSTing to the right endpoint.
In the controller method: verify it creates a `Payment` record linked to the invoice, updates `invoice.status` to `paid`, and THEN redirects — NOT just navigating to the project.
Fix the method to: (a) create the Payment, (b) set invoice to paid, (c) redirect to the invoice detail view with a success flash.
Verify: invoice balance shows $0 outstanding, status shows 'Paid', and the payment appears in the invoice's payment history.
resources: GS-ERP payment controller and route file
`Invoice` and `Payment` models — their status enums and relationships
The invoice detail page — locate the 'Mark as paid' button and its form `action`
Stripe webhook payment handler (reference: how automatic payments are recorded correctly)
`QuickBooksPaymentPoller` (understand what it does so manual payment doesn't conflict)
